detect: a generator meta tag naming the version

order.why: version and plugin set decide which known issues apply at all
order.oracle: a plugin directory or readme.txt naming a version

order.why: the plugin list is the attack surface and it is rarely complete in the UI
order.oracle: a plugin directory reachable that is not listed anywhere

order.why: most WordPress sites sit behind something, and knowing which changes the encoding budget
order.oracle: a response that differs only for a blocked pattern

order.why: plugin queries are where injection lives; core is usually current and plugins are not
order.oracle: a conditional delay or a boolean difference on a plugin parameter

order.why: media uploads and plugin upload forms differ in type checking
order.oracle: a file stored and reachable as executable content

order.why: shared hosting and CDN fronting make framing disagreements common
order.oracle: a request the edge and the origin disagree about

order.why: plugin version claims are unreliable, so prove the behaviour not the version
order.oracle: the control request produces no effect

pitfalls: a readable plugin directory is a finding only with a behaviour, not on its own
version numbers in meta tags are frequently wrong after a partial update
xmlrpc.php open is not a finding unless a specific method does something
not_covered: the block editor REST surface has no entry
